title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
summary: Across the 149 firm-quarter cases, nominal 80% intervals cover reported EPS in 37–70% of returning runs, with most misses above the interval. Six models are compared with reported GAAP EPS, analyst consensus and interval coverage across 149 quarters from 86 US companies; retrospective evidence only.
ai_technology: Six LLM agents extract income-statement drivers from public reports; a shared accounting calculator generates earnings forecasts and intervals.
